Please use this as a firm but respectful letter to your landlord or letting agent. It includes the key facts, a clear repair deadline, and a short evidence checklist.

## Draft Letter for Heating and Bathroom Leak Repairs

**Subject:** Request for urgent repairs: repeated heating failures and leaking bathroom ceiling

Dear [Landlord/Letting Agent Name],

I am writing to formally raise an ongoing repair issue at my apartment in Manchester.

Since **8 January 2026**, we have experienced **repeated heating failures** and a **leaking bathroom ceiling**. I have already reported both issues by email on **two occasions**, but the problems remain unresolved. These faults are affecting day-to-day living and need urgent attention.

I would be grateful if you could arrange the necessary repairs **within 7 days** of this letter and provide a **clear written timeline** for when the work will be inspected and completed. Please also confirm who will be attending and when I should expect access arrangements to be made.

Given the length of time this has been ongoing, I would appreciate prompt written confirmation that the matter is being treated as urgent. I am keen to resolve this amicably and without further delay.

Please reply in writing at your earliest convenience.

Kind regards,
[Your Full Name]
[Your Address]
[Your Phone Number]
[Your Email Address]

## Evidence to Attach

- Copies of the **two previous email reports**
- **Photos or short videos** of the heating issue
- **Photos of the bathroom ceiling leak** and any visible damage
- A **timeline note** showing when the issue started on **2026-01-08**
- Any **messages or replies** from the landlord or agent
- If relevant, a brief note on **temperature impact** or disruption caused
